cause.detail: Zeroshot 10.3.0 native PR delivery invokes `gh api graphql --paginate --slurp`, but the DirectTarget image contains GitHub CLI 2.23.0, whose `gh api` command does not support `--slurp`.

frozen_rule_basis: IF applies because a concrete target installation failure prevented the required observation/delivery. UR requires no demonstrated infrastructure/capability cause; FA requires Broodling SUCCEEDED; neither condition holds.
